note: P3068: concise canonical texts for settings / maintenance actions copied into many drivers. Applied to the publish copy only when en === from (exact). Same meaning, shorter. settingValues (P3071b): dropdown labels replaced only when the option ids match the canon ids in order and every en label equals 'from'; ids/values never change.

adaptive_lighting.from: On by default. Nothing changes until the light is next switched on; a manual change pauses it for 60 min. Untick to disable for this light (global switch: app settings).

to.en: On by default; applies at next switch-on, a manual change pauses it 60 min. Untick to disable here (global: app settings).
to.fr: Actif par défaut ; s'applique au prochain allumage, un réglage manuel le suspend 60 min. Décochez pour l'exclure (global : réglages de l'app).

zcl_cluster_layer.from: Extra command capture, bounded bindings and reporting fallback on top of the native setup. Turn off if this device misbehaves.

to.en: Extra command capture, bindings and reporting fallback. Untick if the device misbehaves.
to.fr: Capture, liaisons et relève de secours en plus. Décochez si l'appareil se comporte mal.

battery_type.from: Select battery type manually or use auto-detection based on voltage

to.fr: Choix manuel, ou Auto (selon la tension)

power_source.from: Select power source manually or use auto-detection

optimization_mode.from: Balance between responsiveness and battery life

enable_power_estimation.from: Estimate power consumption when real measurement is not available (AC/DC devices only)

to.en: Estimate power when not measured (AC/DC only)
to.fr: Estimer la puissance si non mesurée (AC/DC)

battery_critical_threshold.from: Trigger critical battery warning when below this percentage

battery_low_threshold.from: Trigger low battery warning when below this percentage

battery_report_interval.from: How often to request battery status updates

enable_battery_notifications.from: Send flow notifications for battery events
